versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

- Initial public release of the short-drama score pack skill.
- Generates an original pack of 8 to 15 instrumental beds for tension, romance, comedy, and tearjerker scenes.
- Designed for short-drama episodes with reusable, commercially usable BGM tailored to editor needs.
- Integrated workflow for designing, confirming, and generating labeled slots with Beatra via the bundled MCP client.
- Automatic updates and safe runtime checks are enabled by default; extensive recovery, billing, and diagnostic references included.
